snippet.title: PORTALHOPPER | DEMO RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Have you ever wanted to play a game where you do things and then more things happen?

Well then do I have the game for you.

Introducing PORTALHOPPER — the only game that I’ve played and made that is a JRPG AND A PLATFORMER??? YES PLEASE😋😋😋

So yeah. You should go play the demo.
It’s free.
There is literally no reason not to at least try it.

GO PLAY IT. WHY ARE YOU STILL HERE?

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


FIND THE DEMO ON ITCH: https://christiandunlap96.itch.io/portalhopper
FIND THE DEMO ON GAMEJOLT: https://gamejolt.com/games/PORTALHOPPERS/1029373

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
